title: Multifunctional copper–glutathione clusters with superior p-nitrophenol degradation and horseradish peroxidase-like activity
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,8889-8900
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA00897B, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Mayowa Oyebanji, Xuejiao Yang, Ling Chen, Wencai Sun, Ruru Qian, Haizhu Yu, Manzhou Zhu
Herein, an ultrasmall copper–glutathione nanocluster was prepared via one-pot synthesis and acid etching at pH = 2. The formed clusters show superior catalytic efficiency for p-nitrophenol reduction and HRP-like activities.
